When does New Year 2027 start in Turkey?

Turkey uses a single time zone on New Year's Eve, UTC+03:00, so the whole country welcomes 2027 at the same moment: midnight local time corresponds to 21:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Turkey in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Istanbul follows 11 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 14 hours after Istanbul.

When the clock strikes midnight in Istanbul, 53 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC+03:30): Iran
  • Just after (UTC+02:00): Egypt, Greece, Russia (Kaliningrad), South Africa, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burundi, Cyprus and 21 more

Who celebrates at the same time as Turkey?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC+03:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Istanbul: Russia (Moscow), Bahrain, Belarus, Comoros, Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Kuwait, Madagascar and 7 more.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Turkey in UTC?

Midnight in Istanbul corresponds to 21:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

How many time zones does Turkey have on New Year's Eve?

One. The whole country uses UTC+03:00 on New Year's Eve.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Turkey on New Year's Eve?

No. Istanbul keeps UTC+03:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Turkey?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC+03:30, which includes Iran.
